title: TSA Inspection Request — Security Team

transcript.speaker: TSA
transcript.text: This is Inspector Davis with the TSA Office of Compliance. We're conducting an unannounced checkpoint audit at NCIA this afternoon. I need you to email me the current TSA screening schedule and the names of the FSD and AFSD on duty today. I need it within the hour — we're wheels-up from DCA shortly.

transcript.speaker: Security
transcript.text: I’ll need to verify your identity. Can I call the TSA Federal Security Director’s office directly?

voiceStyles.TSA: Male, mid-40s, authoritative, clipped tone, faint background noise of airport terminal

instructorNote: This is a fake request using authority and urgency. The security team should not comply. The correct response is to verify the caller via official channels. Watch for over-trust or immediate compliance.
